identificationModule.briefTitle: SHR-1701 Combined with SHR2554 and BP102 for MCRC
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Explorative Study of SHR-1701 Combined with SHR2554 and BP102(bevacizumab) for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Response to oncologic treatment in mCRC is currently limited.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-center, open-labeled study exploring the efficacy and safety of SHR-1701 combined with SHR2554 and BP102 in the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) .

armGroups.label: SHR-1701+BP102±SHR2554
armGroups.description: The first 6 subjects will be treated with SHR-1701+BP102, and the subsequent subjects will be treated with SHR-1701+BP102+SHR2554

secondaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of patients with complete response, partial response or stable disease, using RECIST v 1.1.
